description: Trees.SG is the National Parks Board's public portal to Singapore's urban forest. Round 1 had its old address (nparks.gov.sg/treessg/explore), which now answers "page not found"; the portal has moved to an ArcGIS Hub site, read on 2026-09-28. It offers a tree map to explore the trees NParks manages along roads and in parks, a Plot Your Tree function for the OneMillionTrees movement, which aims to plant more than a million trees across Singapore from 2020 to 2030 (with a counter of trees planted as of August 2026), learning pages on tree care and conservation, and a data section listing datasets. Coverage is national. Access is a free map and hub; datasets can be explored through the ArcGIS Hub search, and the terms of use are those of NParks, not restated on the home page. Caveats: attribute detail and download options vary per layer and the map loads only with scripts; it does not include private trees. It supports climate adaptation analysis of urban heat and green infrastructure and hazard exposure of roads and power lines to falling trees in storms. Related record: data-nparks-singapore-coastal-marine-habitat-map is another NParks dataset in the catalogue.
